alt: The summary is worth 10 marks: one paragraph of no more than 100 words on the named aspect or aspects of the Exercise 3 text, in your own words. It is marked against R2 and R3 and all five writing objectives, W1 to W5.
caption: A summary is marked as writing as well as reading.

after: ## Step 1: read the aspect, not the text
alt: Five steps: read the aspect named in the question, collect the relevant points, put them in your own words, link them into one paragraph, and check the word count.
caption: Aspect first, then points, own words, links and the count.

alt: Merge repeated points, drop background, examples and quotations, and generalise lists: پودینہ، دھنیا اور ٹماٹر becomes جلدی اگنے والی سبزیاں. Six to eight points is typical for a 100-word, two-aspect summary.
caption: Fewer, broader points: merge repeats and turn lists into one general idea.

after: ## Step 3: put the points in your own words
alt: A table of five paraphrase techniques with Urdu examples: synonym (کمی to قلت), changing the word class, generalising (سیب، آم اور کیلے to پھل), active to passive, and combining two sentences with a connective (شدید بارش کے باعث).
caption: Own words means no lifted phrases, not replacing every single word.

after: ## Step 4: link the points into one paragraph
alt: Connectives grouped by function: addition (اس کے علاوہ، نیز), contrast (تاہم، لیکن), cause (کیونکہ، کے باعث), result (اس لیے، لہٰذا) and sequence (پہلے، پھر، آخر میں). Contrast is highlighted as the hinge for two-aspect questions. Write in neutral third person without an empty opener.
caption: تاہم is the natural hinge between the two halves of a two-aspect summary.

alt: A narrowing list of what to cut when over the limit: repeated ideas first, then introductory phrases, then examples, and finally the least important point. Postpositions and helper verbs such as کے لیے and ہو گیا ہے add words quickly.
caption: Cut repetition and padding before you cut a point.

alt: The six points of the bus-service summary sorted into four advantages and two problems, joined by تاہم. Below, four rewordings: کرایہ رکشے سے آدھا ہے becomes سستی, ہر دس منٹ بعد becomes تھوڑے تھوڑے وقفے سے, بڑی سڑکوں becomes مرکزی شاہراہوں, and the rush-hour crowding becomes کھچا کھچ بھری.
caption: Six points, two halves joined by تاہم, every phrase reworded.

alt: A 15-minute timeline: 4 minutes to collect points, 8 to write and 3 to count and check. Draft in your head or in brief notes, and check once for meaning and once for accuracy.
caption: You already know the text from Exercise 3, so most of the time goes on writing.
